label: The four vows, named
from: A title and an open question
to: Maddy × Cora · Harley × Yvaine · Violet × Nova · Izzy × Fiona
note: Maddy and Cora open the arc. Harley finally asks a question she had been holding since Arc 7. Violet and Nova marry like the sporting wives they are. And Izzy and Fiona — already married, wives before paper — are given a Found Family ceremony to honour them properly. The raccoon attended all four uninvited.
